winnerGroundTruth: who serves the NEXT rally. Under both PAR and English scoring the player who wins a rally serves the next one, so the next server is the winner. The ball is 2-3 px at 854x480 and is never tracked, so the winner is NOT read off the ball.
reasonGroundTruth: NOT ESTABLISHED. Tin vs out vs unreachable cannot be told apart at this resolution. The 'lastShotKind' field below is only whether the last stroke looked like an attacking shot or a scramble, which is a posture judgement, not a rules judgement.
note: Players are identified by kit, not by the engine's A/B boxes. The boxes swap identity within a single montage (archive_match4 b018 tiles 3-5), so scoring the heuristic against engine IDs would have measured the tracker, not the heuristic.
